---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a feature to improve GRIDWISE
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''

---

## 📝 Feature Description

A clear and concise description of what you want to be added.

## 🎯 Use Case

Describe the problem this feature would solve. Why is it needed?

## 💡 Proposed Solution

How do you think this feature should work?

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Describe alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📊 Priority

- [ ] Critical (needed immediately)
- [ ] High (important, should be done soon)
- [ ] Medium (nice to have)
- [ ] Low (future consideration)

## 👥 Who Would Benefit

Who would use this feature?
- [ ] Home users
- [ ] Small businesses
- [ ] Large enterprises
- [ ] Everyone

## 📚 Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples here.

---

**Before suggesting:**
- [ ] I searched existing issues/discussions
- [ ] This feature is not already planned
- [ ] I can explain the use case clearly
